title: An idea about the evolving structure of a Loop Current eddy
query: Drawing on the supplied related work and GLORYS12 data for 6 August 2016–25 July 2017 in the Gulf of Mexico (98–82°W, 18–30°N), develop and investigate a research idea about the evolving vertical structure of a Loop Current-region anticyclonic eddy.

data_scope.depth: Native levels from surface to 2000 m
data_scope.limits: Related work concerns the same region but observed missions are not identical to this reanalysis. The experiment tests a model-resolved feature, not reproduction of the original Poseidon sample.

related_work.title: The Vertical Structure of a Loop Current Eddy
related_work.source_dataset: GMOG Poseidon2016 glider mission0003, 5 August–15 November2016, plus contextual observations.

related_work.title: Erosion of the Subsurface Salinity Maximum of the Loop Current Eddies From Glider Observations and a Numerical Model
related_work.source_dataset: GMOG Poseidon2016–2017 glider observations (6 August2016–25 July2017 analysis) plus a separate numerical model.

related_work.title: On the Seasonal Cycle of Phytoplankton Bio-Optical Properties Inside a Warm Core Ring in the Gulf of Mexico
related_work.source_dataset: GMOG Poseidon missions0003–0006, August2016–August2017; physical and bio-optical sensors; study windows differ across papers.
